description: Create a TestFlight beta group (internal = your own App Store Connect users, external = email invitees). Idempotent by name: a group with that name on the app is returned, not duplicated. Without confirm:true it only checks and says what it would create. Add testers with invite_beta_tester (internal groups take App Store Connect users on the account). Pro feature.

confirm.description: Required to create. Without it the tool only previews.

has_access_to_all_builds.description: Give the group every build automatically. Omit to leave Apple's default.

internal.description: true for an internal group, false for external. No default: they are different products.

name: create_beta_group
title: Create a TestFlight group
